# Qwen 3.0.6 微调实战知识图谱

## 大模型核心特征概览 [BV1bVNR6DEbw P1 01:01]  
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    LM["大模型"]
    Params["参数量巨大（数千亿‑万亿）"]
    Data["训练数据量庞大（PB 级）"]
    Transformer["基于 Transformer 架构"]

    LM --> Params
    LM --> Data
    LM --> Transformer
```

## 模型生态与成本对比 [BV1bVNR6DEbw P1 02:30]  
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Domestic["国产模型"]
    DeepSeek["DeepSeek"]
    Qwen["Qwen"]
    International["国外模型"]
    Cloud["Cloud"]
    GPT55["GPT 5.5"]
    CostLow["成本低（100 万 token ≈ 1 元）"]
    CostHigh["成本高"]
    PerfHigh["性能强/性价比高"]

    Domestic --> DeepSeek
    Domestic --> Qwen
    International --> Cloud
    International --> GPT55
    DeepSeek --> CostLow
    Cloud --> PerfHigh
    GPT55 --> PerfHigh
    Cloud --> CostHigh
```

## 大模型 ↔ 软件/应用类比 [BV1bVNR6DEbw P1 04:34]  
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Model["大模型"]
    Engine["模型（相当于发动机）"]
    AppSoftware["大模型应用软件"]
    Car["汽车"]
    CoreComp["核心组件"]
    Peripheral["其他组件（数据库、缓存、前端等）"]

    Model --> Engine
    Engine --> Car
    Car --> CoreComp
    Car --> Peripheral
    AppSoftware --> Model
    AppSoftware --> Peripheral
```

## 微调全流程概览 [BV1bVNR6DEbw P1 00:24]  
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Intro["概念与原理介绍"]
    DataPrep["数据收集与预处理"]
    FineTune["模型微调"]
    Eval["效果评估"]
    Deploy["部署与推理"]
    Use["用户使用"]

    Intro --> DataPrep --> FineTune --> Eval --> Deploy --> Use
```

## 大模型在应用软件中的角色（以豆包为例） [BV1bVNR6DEbw P1 06:33]  
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    User["用户提问"]
    DoubaoApp["豆包前端应用"]
    Backend["后端服务（转发）"]
    LargeModel["大模型（核心推理）"]
    AnswerGen["答案生成"]
    UI["结果展示"]

    User --> DoubaoApp
    DoubaoApp --> Backend
    Backend --> LargeModel
    LargeModel --> AnswerGen
    AnswerGen --> Backend
    Backend --> UI
    UI --> User
```
